evidence.text:
# Task List

1. ⏳ Reading and clarifying the issue description

2. ⏳ Run repository test suite to see failing tests

3. ⏳ Explore codebase to locate auto-closing pairs logic

4. ⏳ Create a minimal reproduction script for the issue

5. ⏳ Fix analysis: choose approach to resolve overlapping auto-closing pairs

6. ⏳ Implement minimal code changes to fix overlap handling

7. ⏳ Verify fix with reproduction script and run tests

8. ⏳ Final review against issue requirements
